claim.notes: CFR+ (simultaneous updates, linear averaging) over the full tree, 77706 iterations, stopped by the 480 s time budget. Exploitability was still falling slowly (about 4.2e-3 at the end, from 4.5e-3 at 67k iterations), so the strategy is not converged to a tight tolerance. Best-response values: player 0 -0.08198, player 1 +0.09036. Value to player 0 is -0.08561, consistent with the known Leduc value. The best-response routine was validated on a Kuhn tree I generated (which had a payoff sign error in the test game only). Alternating-update CFR+ converged more slowly and was not used. Further iterations or a longer run would tighten the bound.
